responsibility: Implements the NLL- and Chalk-oriented type relating engine that performs subtype, supertype, and equality-style comparisons using universes instead of leak checking, delegates outlives constraints and obligation collection to the caller, and supports higher-ranked binders by instantiating placeholders and existentials during relation.
same_name_distinction: This `mod.rs` is an alternate type-relation engine aimed at NLL/Chalk-style use: it defines `TypeRelating` plus a delegate interface so the caller supplies outlives recording, obligation collection, and universe creation. Unlike `higher_ranked/mod.rs`, it is not just helper machinery for binders, and unlike the main `infer/mod.rs`, it does not own inference state.
